'Gain 1{h}. Gain 1{h}. Gain 1{h}.' / '**Go again**' Earth Wizard Action.

THREE separate GAIN effects, deliberately NOT one GAIN with amount 3: official_release_notes 1 says the card 'will generate three separate gain 1{h} events', and note 2 spells out the consequence - one 'replace the next time you would gain {h}' replacement applies only to the FIRST event, a second replacement to the second. A single amount-3 effect would be one event and both notes would be false. Each GAIN is compiled independently by effect_types.py:4869 and routes LIFE_POINTS through effect_gain_life, so each resolves as its own gain.

ability_type PLAY (triage's spelling): ABILITY_TYPE_TO_EVENT maps PLAY and ACTION to the same ON_PLAY event (trigger_types.py:109-110), so this is cosmetic; PLAY is the DSL_REFERENCE's canonical 'resolves when the card is played'.

Printed **Go again** and **Specialization** are in printed_keywords and fire from the card DB keywords field - deliberately NOT authored here; re-authoring a printed keyword is a defect. (Specialization is a deck-construction restriction plus the go-again rider; both are DB-side.)

No unresolved gaps.
